description: Source code for the SymbolTable class in the ANGLE project, managing symbol tables for shader parsing, including functions for inserting, finding, and managing shader-specific symbols and their properties.

classes.name: TSymbolTable::TSymbolTableLevel
classes.description: Represents a level in the symbol table stack, managing insertion and lookup of symbols and functions.

classes.name: TSymbolTable
classes.description: Manages the collection of symbol table levels, handling symbol insertion, lookup, and shader-specific symbol management.

classes.name: TSymbolTable::VariableMetadata
classes.description: Stores metadata about variables, such as static read/write flags and invariance.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a symbol into the current symbol table level.

methods.name: insertUnmangled
methods.description: Inserts a function using its unmangled name.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a symbol by name within the current level.

methods.name: TSymbolTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the symbol table.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the symbol table is empty.

methods.name: atGlobalLevel
methods.description: Checks if the current scope is the global scope.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a new scope level onto the symbol table stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Pops the current scope level from the symbol table stack.

methods.name: markFunctionHasPrototypeDeclaration
methods.description: Marks a function as having a prototype declaration.

methods.name: setFunctionParameterNamesFromDefinition
methods.description: Sets parameter names for a function based on its definition.

methods.name: setGlInArraySize
methods.description: Sets the array size for the gl_in variable.

methods.name: getGlInVariableWithArraySize
methods.description: Returns the gl_in variable with its array size.

methods.name: gl_FragData
methods.description: Returns the gl_FragData variable.

methods.name: gl_SecondaryFragDataEXT
methods.description: Returns the gl_SecondaryFragDataEXT variable.

methods.name: getOrCreateVariableMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves or creates metadata for a variable.

methods.name: markStaticWrite
methods.description: Marks a variable as statically written.

methods.name: markStaticRead
methods.description: Marks a variable as statically read.

methods.name: isStaticallyUsed
methods.description: Checks if a variable is used statically.

methods.name: addInvariantVarying
methods.description: Marks a variable as an invariant varying.

methods.name: isVaryingInvariant
methods.description: Checks if a variable is an invariant varying.

methods.name: setGlobalInvariant
methods.description: Sets the global invariant flag.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a symbol by name, considering shader version.

methods.name: findUserDefined
methods.description: Finds a user-defined symbol by name.

methods.name: findUserDefinedFunction
methods.description: Finds a user-defined function by name.

methods.name: findGlobal
methods.description: Finds a global symbol by name.

methods.name: findGlobalWithConversion
methods.description: Finds a global symbol with name conversion.

methods.name: findBuiltInWithConversion
methods.description: Finds a built-in symbol with name conversion.

methods.name: declare
methods.description: Declares a new symbol.

methods.name: declareInternal
methods.description: Declares an internal symbol.

methods.name: declareUserDefinedFunction
methods.description: Declares a user-defined function.

methods.name: setDefaultPrecision
methods.description: Sets the default precision for a type.

methods.name: getDefaultPrecision
methods.description: Gets the default precision for a type.

methods.name: clearCompilationResults
methods.description: Clears compilation results and resets state.

methods.name: nextUniqueIdValue
methods.description: Generates the next unique ID.

methods.name: initializeBuiltIns
methods.description: Initializes built-in shader variables and settings.

methods.name: initSamplerDefaultPrecision
methods.description: Initializes default precision for sampler types.
